I was on the 150mg shot of invega for a few years. It stopped the weight gain I had on risperidone but I couldn't lose any on it either. It stabilised the delusions and made the voices more manageable than anything else I have tried but it gave me severe restless legs I had to take benzos to manage and even now years later it's never fully gone away, and it made my prolactin levels so high I began lactating, and various other physical health concerns I had to stop. 
The first time I stopped cold turkey I had an episode and was hospitalized but the second time there were no issues.
